run_speech_edit: run speech editing on an audio file by replacing specified time segments with new target text
build_mel_spectrogram: build a mel spectrogram from raw audio using the configured mel_spec parameters and device
edit_mel_cond: edit a mel spectrogram condition by inserting zero frames at specified time ranges for text replacement
sample_generated_audio: sample generated audio from the CFM model using mel condition, text, and edit mask
save_speech_edit_output: save the generated speech edit output as both a WAV audio file and a spectrogram PNG image
